public.title: Object Update II
public.description: input {value,updates}; each update has path (nonempty key/index array), op set or add, and value. Set replaces the final value; add increments an existing integer leaf. Missing ancestors are created as arrays if the next token is numeric, otherwise objects. Existing ancestors have correct kinds, array writes are contiguous. Return {original,updated}. At most 8 path segments and 20 updates; this fixed add updater substitutes for callback values. Supported inputs are valid for this contract. Aggregate JSON-serialized input is at most 512 UTF-8 bytes, nesting depth at most 6, arrays at most 40 items, operation/call lists at most 20 items, and individual strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless a tighter bound is stated. Integers have absolute value at most 1000; output arithmetic stays within safe integers. String object keys and string path segments are nonempty safe alphanumeric/underscore names excluding __proto__, constructor and prototype. Empty arrays/objects are allowed where consistent with the contract. Output ordering follows the rules above. These bounds include all nested payloads and all operations together.
hints: Separate the documented JSON representation from the behavior being modeled.
Preserve ordering and distinguish missing values, null, zero and false carefully.
